claims.head: Special teams lean toward the Mammoth
claims.call: The Mammoth’s power play creates at least their usual 8.4 expected goals per 60.
claims.body: The Bruins’ penalty kill is near the bottom of the league, and the Mammoth’s power play is near the top. Discipline matters more than usual for the Bruins tonight.

claims.head: Sheltered vs. Exposed
claims.body: The Bruins keep dangerous shots away, but the Mammoth give up a lot of them. Boston is near the top of the league for preventing dangerous shots, and Utah is one of the worst. The more dangerous chances should come at the Mammoth’s net.

BOS.head: A slightly uphill night for the Bruins
BOS.body: Even though Boston has home-ice advantage, Utah has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately. The Bruins’ best way to tip it is getting good looks.

UTA.head: The Mammoth start a half-step ahead
UTA.body: Even though Boston has home-ice advantage, Utah has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately. Still, it’s close: the Bruins can make it interesting if they get good looks.
